about: Recorded sizes in bytes of the shipped engine binaries, checked by tools/binary-budget.py (issue 551). A binary may be at most `tolerance` above its budget. Start of the ratchet: the size table of issue 551 (main 2ff4472d2 + PR 540, macOS arm64; Wasm from the same build). Lower a budget with `tools/binary-budget.py check --update`; raise one only by hand, in a reviewed change that says why. leanjs darwin-arm64 raised 11,420,160 -> 11,868,032 B (+3.9%) at the merge of main 8d3af851b: PRs merged since (550 undo log in JS/UndoLog and the evaluator, 547/549, 537) grew it; measured on the merged state. leanjs darwin-arm64 lowered 11,868,032 -> 11,483,024 B (-3.2%): the undo log's logging branch is a call (HeapOf.noteObjOn, noteEnvOn), not expanded at each heap write. web-render.wasm raised 49,542,896 -> 50,703,168 B and web-render.wasm.br 5,925,520 -> 6,066,156 B (owner-approved 2026-11-17, PR 590): main had already grown to +1.51% (50,289,963 B at e5ab9084b) and the ten WPT branches of PR 590 add about 412 KB (+0.82%) for +3,110 WPT subtests; no cheap trim was found. Measured on build.yml 44119004965. Rebaseline web-render.wasm and web-render.wasm.br to 52,592,214 and 6,293,040 B, respectively, measured on main 14fbe357d906 in build.yml 45402939972. The shared Wasm size gate blocked full Foafnaut packaging on macOS. The budget continues to reject growth beyond the existing 2% tolerance.
